issue.title: Flight testing DroneCore examples on Intel Aero
issue.body:
@dronecore/testflights can you please help us verify the following documentation examples run on the Intel Aero:

* [Takeoff and Land](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/tree/develop/example/takeoff_land)
* Fly QGC mission. You can use [dronecore/DroneCore/#235](#235) which flies QGroundControl Mission plan
* [Offboard velocity control](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/tree/develop/example/offboard_velocity)
* [GPS Follow Me](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/tree/develop/example/follow_me)

Please try to follow the steps in our docs to build and run the examples
* [Building DroneCore from source](https://docs.dronecore.io/en/contributing/build.html)
* [Running examples](https://docs.dronecore.io/en/examples/)

We are looking for all levels of feedback, from "steps are wrong, we can't build" to "vehicle flew in the wrong direction".

@shakthi-prashanth-m @anitha-suresh @julianoes @JonasVautherin how would you guys like the feedback from the test team? logs? command line output? screenshots?
